title: Line-by-line verification performed this session (arena/0e86aefb-own4)
method: Each value below was re-read from the official nfl.com page listed and compared to the committed nfl-book dataset. Values that match are PASS. Nothing is inferred; nothing is filled in. Unverifiable values remain blank and flagged (flags.json).

checks.item: 2026 NFL league standings (32 clubs): W-L-T, PCT, PF, PA
checks.detail: Re-read line by line on 2026-11-16. Committed feed (captured 2026-11-14) is a dated snapshot: internal reconciliation exact (137 games, 32 clubs, sum GP/2 = 137, sum PF = sum PA = 6664 across committed feed). Official page has since advanced (e.g., BUF 8-1 vs snapshot 7-1) because later games were played — expected for a point-in-time snapshot, not an error. snapshot labelled standings_2026-11-14.

Official game page: WAS 24, NYG 21, Final. Matches committed results_feed row W10-WAS-NYG (away WAS 24, home NYG 21). Venue: MetLife Stadium, East Rutherford NJ. Game Book PDF link present on official page.
Official game page: NE 10, SEA 13, Final. Matches committed results_feed row W01-NE-SEA (away NE 10, home SEA 13). Venue: Lumen Field, Seattle WA. Game Book PDF link present on official page.

All 8 chunks read line by line on 2026-11-16T22:10:00Z: 347 player rows across 28 clubs (CHI, DEN, PHI, TB on bye), every row with fetch clock and chunk attribution, blank cells preserved. Replaces prior 2-of-8 chunk capture (FB-06 closed). Caveat: official page mislabels players under wrong team headers (FB-18); rows transcribed exactly as published, no team corrected or inferred.

own_lines_open.json and own_lines_close.json each assert origination_order == ["side", "total", "moneyline"]; every market row carries that order. Week 11: 13 games originated (6 byes), matching the official Week 11 schedule.

The NFL publishes no betting lines, odds, or prices anywhere on nfl.com. All market_open_value / market_close_value / market_line / difference cells are null and explicitly labelled 'no official price source — blank by policy (FB-01)'. No price is inferred.

checks.item: Pre-registration: strategies registered before results seen
checks.detail: strategies.json carries registered_utc and a pre-registration note; gates.json carries registered_utc and a pre-registration note (commit hash is the registration). Leaderboard points_awarded = 0 while G7 (verified prices) is blocked (amendment A1).
Leaderboard ranks on signal tier only; staking shown under an ASSUMED -110 price (FB-02) and never promotes a strategy or pays points (amendment A1). 0 of 1,000 points paid.

D1 defined with 4 firing conditions, auto live->paper, no human approval, re-promotion requires re-passing G1-G6 and G8 on unseen data. No strategy holds LIVE status (all PAPER or BLOCKED), so D1 has not fired.

checks.item: Correlations from official scores only, n published
checks.detail: correlations.json: computed values use official scores only, each published with n; uncomputable/player-level values blank with reasons. CR-03 same-week legs r≈0 (independence not rejected, n=125).

checks.item: Decision-readiness table one row per requirement
checks.detail: Landing page carries R01-R20, each with status, blocking gate, the number/evidence that would clear it, and an official source link.

checks.item: Game Book availability for actual starters
checks.detail: Official game pages expose a 'Download Game Book (PDF)' link (official starters/substitutes/inactives). Not parsed this session; listed as the official source for starter evidence (R10/R11 depend on it).

irregularities_confirmed.title: Official injury page team labels are inconsistent
irregularities_confirmed.detail: 19 documented examples of players printed under the wrong club header on nfl.com/injuries/; rows transcribed as published, none corrected.

irregularities_confirmed.title: No official market price source exists
irregularities_confirmed.detail: Permanent; blocks fair-vs-market difference, residuals, CLV, vig decomposition, ROI, and rewards until an official price source exists.

irregularities_confirmed.title: No official depth chart
irregularities_confirmed.detail: nfl.com depth-chart routes do not resolve; depth from playing time / snap counts not available from an official source.

conclusion: All re-readable committed values checked this session match their official sources. Remaining gaps (market prices, depth charts, snap counts, player-prop prices) are structural — the NFL does not publish them — and are published blank and flagged, never inferred.
